item.title: Designing Italics Resources
item.description: Hi everybody, this is my first forum post!! I am new to type design, and I have create a roman, lowercase and uppercase, and I was wondering if anyone knew of resources to create italics. Something like Karen Cheng’s Designing type. I have found the FontForge guide on designing italics. Any help is appreciated!
